Great for beginners!|Store Description}} {{QuoteBox|A cheap and effective burst tower.|Former Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Soldier''' is a starter ground tower that fires in bursts. It can be bought for {{Coins|350}} in the store. The '''Soldier''' fires in bursts, with a short delay between each burst. It is a fairly cheap tower, making it recommended for use in earlier waves. It gains hidden detection at Level 2 and flying detection at Level 4 (Level 0 for [[PVP]]), so it is an effective counter against [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] and [[Flying]] enemies. The '''Soldier''' is considered an early to mid-game tower. Later on during the game, its effectiveness dwindles against high health enemies, being outclassed by other towers with higher DPS. ==Upgrades== {{PVPTabber |{{Upgrade|Level = Level 1|Upgrade Title = |[[File:PatrioticSoldierIconIG.png|175px]] |[[File:BeachSoldierIconIG.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Patriotic}} |{{Color|Beach}} |- !Rarity |{{Color|Rare}} |{{Color|Rare}} |- !Daily Store Cost |{{Coins|6,500}} |{{Coins|6,500}} |- !Obtained From |[[Patriotic Crate]] |[[Beach Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Soldier''' is an effective early-game tower at Level 2, having high DPS for a cheap price. **By mid-game, you should have multiple Level 3–4 '''Soldiers''', as they can effectively kill enemies that appear there, such as the [[Dark Necromancer]] or [[Slow Boss]]. ***However, it loses value as the waves progress due to its DPS being too low to deal with high health enemies that appear later on during the game. ***It should not be relied on late-game if you have better towers and can be replaced by towers like the [[Minigunner]] or [[Ranger]]. *The '''Soldier''' is able to change targets between bursts if another enemy enters its range. **This avoids the need to swap targets from time to time. *The '''Soldier's''' firerate can be boosted by the [[Commander]]. **However, the '''Soldier's''' cooldown cannot be decreased. **However, it is not recommended to prioritize this tower over higher DPS alternatives such as the [[Minigunner]] and [[Turret]]. ==Trivia== *When the game was in Alpha, and for a while after BETA release, the '''Soldier's''' upgrade stats were not displayed on its upgrade description. It was simply referred to as "''sans gun''". *The '''Soldier's''' name and function is very loosely based on the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Soldier|Soldier]] from ''Tower Battles''. *The '''Soldier''', along with the [[Turret]], are the first towers to have toys made based on them. **They are also the first to have mini-figures made based on them, as they appear in the [[Roblox Core Pack -
